blocks.text: There is something comforting about finding a place that naturally fits into your day. Sometimes it’s where you answer emails before lunch, catch up with friends after class, finish a deadline over coffee, or simply pause for a quiet afternoon with a slice of cake in hand. For the past year, Bayfront CoLive+ Café+ has quietly become one of those places. As Bayfront CoLive+ marks its first anniversary this October, Café+ celebrates not just twelve months of serving coffee and cakes, but a year of becoming part of the everyday routines of students, professionals, digital nomads, travelers, and neighborhood regulars who […]...
